dedupe_keys.name: bulgarian residential building database for city energy analyst cea 4

description: This Zenodo record, by Sinda M'Saada, Martina Ivanova and Yordan Mitev, is described as the first open-source, country-specific residential building database for Bulgaria built for the City Energy Analyst version 4 urban building energy modelling tool. It supplies the archetype, assembly and schedule data needed to simulate heating, domestic hot water and electricity demand of the Bulgarian residential stock at district or city scale. It follows the standard CEA-4 database schema of archetypes, assemblies and components and was built from the Swiss default database as a structural template, with Bulgarian values substituted where they affect building energy demand. Coverage: the residential building stock of Bulgaria. Access: the record, published 2026-07-13, is restricted on Zenodo, so files must be requested from the creators. Licence: MIT; free. Caveats: file contents could not be inspected on the day, and values not substituted keep the Swiss defaults. Simulation uses are district and city energy demand scenarios for Bulgarian housing, retrofit and heating planning with CEA. Related records: the City Energy Analyst model record.
